title: Hoosier Haunts: Hauntings at the State Sanatorium
excerpt: Visitors and paranormal investigators report shadow figures, unexplained encounters and an overwhelming sense of sadness at the historic property.
content:
Rockville, Ind. (WLFI) - The halls of the Indiana State Sanatorium are filled with decades of history. But according to some visitors and paranormal investigators, the property may also hold unexplained activity.

As part of News 18’s Hoosier Haunts series, News 18’s Cody Melin and Dominic Lanham explored the historic grounds to learn more about the sanatorium’s haunted reputation and the experiences people say they’ve had inside.

“The word paranormal means we can’t explain it. And there’s a lot of things here I can’t explain,” said Steve Cecchin, business manager with the Sanatorium Project.

From shadowy figures moving through hallways to visitors reporting unexplained physical encounters, Cecchin said reports of paranormal activity have come from throughout the property.

One frequently reported location is the base of a staircase inside the former tuberculosis hospital. Cecchin said numerous visitors, particularly women, have reported feeling sick or uncomfortable in the area.

“Most of the reports are that the woman then immediately says, ‘I need to be off this property. We need to get in our car and drive away,’” Cecchin said.

Despite the reports surrounding the staircase, paranormal activity is not limited to one particular area.

“Many people have felt like a tap on the shoulder,” Cecchin said.

Some visitors have also reported physical encounters, including unexplained scratches.

“Many people have showed me their skin, or a picture of where they got like a scratch,” Cecchin said.

Another area that draws attention from paranormal investigators is a wing of the former nursing home known as Shadow Hallway.

Cecchin said visitors have reported seeing shadowy figures moving from room to room, sometimes appearing in doorways or looking out windows.

“Most people that go there see shadows of people, some large, 10-foot-tall, going room to room, poking their head out the window, out of the doorway...I mean, into the hallway,” Cecchin said.

Some believe the reported activity could be connected to former patients who remain attached to the property.

Cecchin shared a story about a former patient who reportedly lived in a room along Shadow Hallway and may not welcome the attention from visitors.

“Volunteers know of the name of a patient who lived in the second door on the right, and the story that they tell me is that he does not like all the attention of the visitors coming here. He feels like a lion in a circus,” Cecchin said.

Not everyone who visits the sanatorium experiences something they would describe as paranormal. However, Cecchin said many people report a noticeable change in the atmosphere.

“Many, many, many reports of just like a sense of heaviness, a sense of foreboding,” Cecchin said.

The property’s history includes several tragic events that some believe could contribute to its unsettling reputation.

One story involves an engineer who worked at the coal power plant and reportedly shot and killed a co-worker before taking his own life.

Another account involves a patient with schizophrenia who died after reportedly telling others about a ghostly nurse who had been unkind to her.

“She came out during a snowstorm. The story I heard, she took off all her clothes, climbed the water tower and froze to death,” Cecchin said.

Whether visitors attribute their experiences to paranormal activity or the weight of the property’s history, the Indiana State Sanatorium continues to draw people interested in exploring its past.

For those willing to walk its halls, the stories surrounding the property offer a glimpse into a history that some believe has yet to be left behind.
